gloss: to challenge, to confront, to take on

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {挑|いど}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to challenge, to confront, to take on
definitions.explanation: To boldly face a difficult opponent, task, or situation. Implies courage and determination in the face of difficulty. Often used with に to mark the challenge being faced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む。
examples.english: I take on a new challenge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む{若|わか}い⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There is a young athlete challenging the world champion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れ→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧ず、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{挑|いど}む⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to have the attitude of taking on challenges again and again without fearing failure.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The challenge or opponent is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む.

ASPECT (ている):
{挑|いど}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes an ongoing challenge or confrontation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む: to challenge X, to take on X

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む: to take on a match
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む: to attempt to break a record
- ⟦{難題|なんだい}→難題：16722_nandai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{挑|いど}む: to tackle a difficult problem
- {挑|いど}む⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: a challenging attitude, willingness to take on challenges

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧: to challenge (suru verb, more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to stand up against, to confront
